40012288.author: पदार्थः
40012288.content: सः रावणः that Ravana, परिवृताम् surrounded, दीनाम् depressed, निरानन्दाम् sorrowful, तपस्विनीम् ascetic, ताम् her, साकारैः with animated words, मधुरै with sweet, वाक्यैः words, न्यदर्शयत expressed

40012288.author: Translation
40012288.content: Ravana expressed his intention in sweet words to the depressed and griefstricken ascetic Sita surrounded by demon guards:

40012289.author: पदार्थः
40012289.content: नागनासोरु with thighs like the trunk of an elephant, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, स्तनोदरम् breasts and belly, गूहमाना concealed, त्वम् you, भयात् through fear, आत्मानम् by yourself, अदर्शनम् concealed, नेतुम  from me, इच्छसीव you want.

40012289.author: Translation
40012289.content: "On seeing me, Sita, you want to conceal your thighs, belly and breasts through fear of me. I think you do not want me to see you.

40012290.author: पदार्थः
40012290.content: विशालाक्षि largeeyed, सर्वाङ्गगुणसम्पन्ने richly endowed with beauty in all limbs, सर्वलोकमनोहरे delight of all the worlds, त्वाम् you, कामये  desire, प्रिये dear, माम् me, बहुमन्यस्व oblige.

40012290.author: Translation
40012290.content: "O largeeyed one  you are endowed with beauty in all limbs. You are the delight of all worlds. I desire you, dear  Oblige me.

40012291.author: पदार्थः
40012291.content: सीते O Sita, इह here, मनुष्याः वा human beings or, कामरूपिणः those who can change their form at their will, राक्षसाः वा or demons, केचित् none, मत्तः of me, समुत्थितम् born, ते to you, भयम् fear, व्यपसर्पतु  relieve.

40012291.author: Translation
40012291.content: "O Sita no human or demon. who can take any form at their will can relieve your fear born of me.

40012292.author: पदार्थः
40012292.content: भीरु a timid lady, परस्त्रीणाम् at wives of others, गमनं वा having unrighteous, सम्प्रमथ्य  by force, हरणं वा or abduction, रक्षसाम् for demons, सर्वथैव by all means, स्वधर्मः is natural, संशयः doubt, न not.

40012292.author: Translation
40012292.content: "O timid lady having an unrighteous approach to wives of others or their abduction by force is natural to demons, There is no doubt.

40012293.author: पदार्थः
40012293.content: मैथिलि Mythili, एतत् this, एवम् in this manner, कामः passion, कामम् passion, यथाकामम् as it desires, मे  my, शरीरे  body, प्रवर्तताम् may sway, तु indeed, अकामाम् not force to accept my desire, त्वाम् to you, न स्प्रक्ष्यामि I will not touch.

40012293.author: Translation
40012293.content: "Mythili  let passion hold its sway over my body as it will. But I shall not force you or touch you since you do not love me.

40012294.author: पदार्थः
40012294.content: देवि O lady, इह here, भयम् fear, न कार्यम् no need to feel, प्रिये O dear, मयि in me, विश्वसिहि trust me, तत्त्वेन truly, प्रणयस्व love me, एवम् that way, शोकलालसा entertaining sorrow, मा भूः you should not be.

40012294.author: Translation
40012294.content: "O reverend lady, fear not me on that account. Have confidence in me. Show your love. Do not be swayed by grief .

40012295.author: पदार्थः
40012295.content: एकवेणी O lady with a single braid of hair, धराशय्या sleeping on the ground, ध्यानम् brooding, मलिनम् soiled, अम्बरम् clothes, अस्थाने without an occasion, उपवासश्च by fasting, एतानि these, ते to you, औपयिकानि not fit for you, न not.

40012295.author: Translation
40012295.content: "O Lady, to wear a single braid, sleep on the ground, brooding, wearing soiled clothes and fasting without proper occasion does not suit you.

40012296.author: पदार्थः
40012296.content: मैथिलि Mythili, माम् me, प्राप्य having secured, विचित्राणि wonderful, माल्यानि garlands, चन्दनानि sandal, अगरूणि incense, विविधानि several kinds, वासांसि च garments, दिव्यानि divine one, आभरणानि च ornaments, महार्हाणि rich, पानानि drinks, शयनानि bed also, आसनानि च and seats, गीतम् singing, नृत्तं च and dancing, वाद्यं च and musical instruments, लभ you may take

40012296.author: Translation
40012296.content: "O Mythili having secured me, you get all these comforts wonderful garlands, sandal, incense, garments and beautiful ornaments, rich drinks, beds and seats.You can enjoy songs, dances accompanied by musical instruments.

40012297.author: पदार्थः
40012297.content: मैथिलि Mythili, माम् me, प्राप्य having secured, विचित्राणि wonderful, माल्यानि garlands, चन्दनानि sandal, अगरूणि incense, विविधानि several kinds, वासांसि च garments, दिव्यानि divine one, आभरणानि च ornaments, महार्हाणि rich, पानानि drinks, शयनानि bed also, आसनानि च and seats, गीतम् singing, नृत्तं च and dancing, वाद्यं च and musical instruments, लभ you may take

40012297.author: Translation
40012297.content: "O Mythili having secured me, you get all these comforts wonderful garlands, sandal, incense, garments and beautiful ornaments, rich drinks, beds and seats.You can enjoy songs, dances accompanied by musical instruments.

40012298.author: पदार्थः
40012298.content: स्त्रीरत्नम् a jewel among women, असि you are, एवम् this way, मा भूः do not remain like this, गात्रेषु for your limbs, भूषणम् decoration, कुरु you do, सुविग्रहे lady of beautiful body, माम् me, प्राप्य having secured, त्वम् you, अनर्हा be undeserving, कथं नु how can you, स्याः be.

40012298.author: Translation
40012298.content: "You are a, a jewel among women. You should not  remain like this. You  should adorn yourself properly. How can you remain deprived after having me?

40012299.author: पदार्थः
40012299.content: चारु beautiful, सञ्जातम् created, इदम् this, ते यौवनम् your youth, व्यतिवर्तते will pass away, यत् since, शीघ्रम् fast, अतीतम् a past, अपाम् water, स्रोतः इव like flow, पुनः again, नैति does not come.

40012299.author: Translation
40012299.content: "Your charming youth should not pass away (uselessly). A past event does not come back like a current of stream.

40012300.author: पदार्थः
40012300.content: शुभदर्शने lady of auspicious looks, रूपकर्ता creator, सः he, विश्वसृक् one who creates the world, त्वाम् you, कृत्वा having created, उपरतः he stopped, मन्ये I think, अन्या other lady, तव रूपोपमा comparable to your beauty, नास्ति हि indeed does not exist.

40012300.author: Translation
40012300.content: "O lady  with auspicious looks Me thinks, the creator must have retired after creating your beautiful form. For there is no one comparable to you in beauty.

40012301.author: पदार्थः
40012301.content: वैदेहि Vaidehi, रूपयौवनशालिनीम् endowed with (extraordinary) beauty and (exuberant) youth, त्वाम्  you, समासाद्य after getting, साक्षात् personally, पितामहः grandsire, कः who, पुमान् man, अतिवर्तेत retain his balance of mind.

40012301.author: Translation
40012301.content: "O Vaidehi you have (extraordinary) beauty  and (exuberant) youth. Who would not lose his balance of mind even if he were Brahma the grandsire himself after getting you?

40012302.author: पदार्थः
40012302.content: शीतांशुसदृशानने with face like the cool fullmoon, पृथुश्रोणि heavyhipped, ते your, यद्यत् whichever, गात्रम् limb, पश्यामि I see, तस्मिन् तस्मिन् एच whichever limb I behold, मम my, चक्षुः eyes, निबध्यते unable to extricate.

40012302.author: Translation
40012302.content: "O one with a face like the cool fullmoon, with heavy hips. I am unable to extricate my eyes from any limb (of your body) I see.

40012303.author: पदार्थः
40012303.content: मैथिलि O Mythili, मे my, भार्या wife, भव be, एनम् this, मोहम् delusion, विसर्जय give up, इतस्ततः from here and there, आहृतानाम् brought, बह्वीनाम् of many women, मम my, उत्तमस्त्रीणाम् among the best women, सर्वासामेव of all of them, अग्रमहिषी the chief consort, भव be, ते भद्रम् be blessed৷৷

40012303.author: Translation
40012303.content: "O Mythili  be my wife. Give up this (folly due to) delusion. Be my chief consort among the several excellent women I have picked up here and there. Be blessed.

40012304.author: पदार्थः
40012304.content: भीरु a timid lady, लोकेभ्यः from the worlds, यानि those, रत्नानि gems, सम्प्रमथ्य by force, आहृतानि brought, वै indeed, तानि those, सर्वाणि all of them, मे myself, एतत् this, राज्यम् this kingdom, अहं च and I, ते to you.

40012304.author: Translation
40012304.content: "O timid lady, gems brought forcibly from all the worlds, this kingdom as well as myself are yours.

40012305.author: पदार्थः
40012305.content: विलासिनि a lovely lady, नानानगरमालिनीम् different cities forming a garland, सर्वाम् all, पृथिवीम् land, विजित्य winning, तव हेतोः for your sake, जनकाय to Janaka, प्रदास्यामि will give.

40012305.author: Translation
40012305.content: "O lovely lady I will win all the cities and lands and give them to Janaka for your sake.

40012306.author: पदार्थः
40012306.content: यः whoever, मे to me, प्रतिबलः a rival, भवेत् may be, अन्यम् and no other hero, इह लोके in this world, न पश्यामि I cannot see, आहवे in a battle, अप्रितिद्वन्द्वम् unrivalled, मे my, सुमहत् great, वीर्यम् virility, पश्य you may see.

40012306.author: Translation
40012306.content: "I'm unrivalled in this entire world. Behold my matchless virility which permits no rival in war.

40012307.author: पदार्थः
40012307.content: मया by me, असकृत् again and again, संयुगे in battle, भग्नाः shattered, विमृदितध्वजाः their flags crushed, सुरासुराः gods and demons, मम my, प्रत्यनीकेषु in the wars against me, स्थातुम् to stand, अशक्ताः unable.

40012307.author: Translation
40012307.content: "The gods and demons were unable to withstand my power in wars fought against me. They were often shattered and defeated with their flags crushed in war.

40012308.author: पदार्थः
40012308.content: माम् me, इच्छ love, अद्य today, तव your, उत्तमम् best, प्रतिकर्म decoration, क्रियताम् do, तव your, अङ्गे on limbs, सप्रभाणि radiant ones, भूषणानि च ornaments, अवसज्यन्ताम् wear, प्रतिकर्मणा युक्तम् by decorating yourself, ते your, रूपम् form, साधु pleasingly, पश्यामि I wish to see.

40012308.author: Translation
40012308.content: "Offer your love to me. Get yourself decorated in an excellent way. Wear glowing ornaments on your limbs. Let me see you in pleasingly decorated form.

40012309.author: पदार्थः
40012309.content: माम् me, इच्छ love, अद्य today, तव your, उत्तमम् best, प्रतिकर्म decoration, क्रियताम् do, तव your, अङ्गे on limbs, सप्रभाणि radiant ones, भूषणानि च ornaments, अवसज्यन्ताम् wear, प्रतिकर्मणा युक्तम् by decorating yourself, ते your, रूपम् form, साधु pleasingly, पश्यामि I wish to see.

40012309.author: Translation
40012309.content: "Offer your love to me. Get yourself decorated in an excellent way. Wear glowing ornaments on your limbs. Let me see you in pleasingly decorated form.

40012310.author: पदार्थः
40012310.content: वरानने O charming lady, भीरु timid lady, दाक्षिण्येन liberally, प्रतिकर्माभिसंयुक्ता decoration, यथाकामम् as you please, भोगान् luxuries, भुंक्ष्व enjoy, पिब drink, रमस्व च and enjoy.

40012310.author: Translation
40012310.content: "O charming lady decorate yourself liberally. Enjoy these pleasures as you please. Drink and make merry.

40012311.author: पदार्थः
40012311.content: त्वम् yourself, पृथिवीम् the land, धनानि च and wealth also, यथेच्छम् as you wish, प्रयच्छ donate, विस्रब्धा being free, मयि with me, ललस्व enjoy, धृष्टम् boldly, आज्ञापयस्व च and command.

40012311.author: Translation
40012311.content: "Give away land and wealth as you wish. Enjoy with me freely and command me boldly. I will obey you by all means.

40012312.author: पदार्थः
40012312.content: मत्प्रसादात् by my grace, ललन्त्याः enjoying, तव your, बान्धवा relations, ललन्ताम् enjoy, भद्रे auspicious, त्वम् you, मम my, ऋद्धिम् affluence, मे my, यशश्च fame, अनुपश्य you will see.

40012312.author: Translation
40012312.content: "O blessed lady, see my affluence and my fame. Seeing you enjoy (life) by my grace all your kinsmen will follow.

40012313.author: पदार्थः
40012313.content: सुभगे O beautiful lady, चीरवाससा person clad in bark robes, रामेण with Rama, किम् what, करिष्यसि will do, निक्षिप्तविजयः renounced triumph of warrior, गतश्रीः he lost his fortune, वनगोचरः wanderer in the forest, व्रती following asceticism, स्थण्डिलशायी च sleeping on the ground, रामः Rama, जीवति वा alive or, न वा not alive, शङ्के I am doubtful.

40012313.author: Translation
40012313.content: "O beautiful lady Rama has renounced victory, he has lost his fortune. Clad in bark, he is wandering in the forest following asceticism and sleeping on the ground. What can he do  for you? I am in doubt if he is alive or not.

40012314.author: पदार्थः
40012314.content: वैदेहि Vaidehi, रामः Rama, त्वाम् you, पुरोबलाकैः cranes in front, असितैः dark , मेघैः clouds, आवृताम् veiled, ज्योत्स्नामिव like moonbeams, द्रष्टुं वापि even to see, न हि उपलप्स्यते not possible.

40012314.author: Translation
40012314.content: "O Vaidehi I wonder if Rama can see you at all. You are like moonlight veiled by dark clouds and  cannot  be seen even by the flying cranes.

40012315.author: पदार्थः
40012315.content: हिरण्यकशिपुः Hiranyakasipu, इन्द्रहस्तगताम् from Indra, कीर्तिमिव like fame, राघवः Raghava, मम my, हस्तात् from the hands, त्वाम् you, प्राप्तुम् to win, न चापि अर्हति he will not be able.

40012315.author: Translation
40012315.content: "Surely Raghava will not be able to win you back from my hands any more than the demon Hiranyakasipu was able to usurp the fame of Indra.

40012316.author: पदार्थः
40012316.content: चारुस्मिते lady of charming smile, चारुदति lady of beautiful teeth, चारुनेत्रे beautifuleyed, विलासिनि luxurious, भीरु timid one, सुपर्णः Garuda, पन्नगं यथा like serpent, मे my, मनः mind, हरसि attract.

40012316.author: Translation
40012316.content: "O lovely, timid lady your smile, your teeth and your eyes are bewitching. Just as Garuda snatches away a serpent, you ravish my mind by your beauty.

40012317.author: पदार्थः
40012317.content: क्लिष्टकौशेयवसनाम् wearing soiled silk clothes, तन्वीम् beautiful, त्वाम् you, अनलङ्कृतामपि even when you are not decorated, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, अहम् I, स्वेषु at my own, दारेषु wives, रतिम् love, नोपलभामि I find not.

40012317.author: Translation
40012317.content: "Even when you are attired in soiled silk and are bereft of ornaments, I find no interest in my own wives.

40012318.author: पदार्थः
40012318.content: जानकि Janaki, मम my, अन्तःपुरनिवासिन्यः residing in the harem of the royal palace, सर्वगुणान्विताः endowed with all virtues, यावन्त्यः many of them, स्त्रियः women, सर्वासाम् for all of them, ऐश्वर्यम् authority, कुरु you may exercise.

40012318.author: Translation
40012318.content: "O Janaki There are a number of virtuous consorts residing in the harem of my royal palace. You may exercise your authority on all of them.

40012319.author: पदार्थः
40012319.content: असितकेशान्ते lady of dark tresses, मम me, ताः those, त्रैलोक्यप्रवराः best among the women in the three worlds, स्त्रियः women, अप्सरस: apsaras, श्रियं यथा like goddess Lakshmi, त्वाम् you, परिचरिष्यन्ति will attend on you.

40012319.author: Translation
40012319.content: O lady of dark tresses, those women who belong to me, the finest in the three worlds, will wait upon you as apsaras attend on Lakshmi.

40012320.author: पदार्थः
40012320.content: सुश्रोणि heavyhipped, सुभ्रु lady of beautiful brows, वैश्रवणे with Vaisravana, यानि all such, रत्नानि gems, धनानि च and wealth, तानि those, लोकांश्च worlds also, मां च me as well, यथासुखम् be happy, भुङ्क्ष्व you may enjoy.

40012320.author: Translation
40012320.content: "O Sita of heavy hips and beautiful brows Be happy. Enjoy all the worlds of mine, the gems and wealth of Ravana.

40012321.author: पदार्थः
40012321.content: देवि queen, रामः Rama, तपसा by penance, मया to me, न तुल्यः not equal, बलेन by prowess, न विक्रमैः nor by valour, न not, धनेन in wealth, तेजसा in brilliance, यशसापि वा or even in fame, न not.

40012321.author: Translation
40012321.content: "O queen Rama is not equal to me  either in penance or prowess or valour or wealth or brilliance or even in fame.

40012322.author: पदार्थः
40012322.content: ललने O delightful one, धननिचयम् heaps of riches, मेदिनीं च and land, प्रदिशामि will present you, त्वम् you, पिब  drink, विहर sport, रमस्व enjoy yourself, भोगान्  all pleasures, भुङ्क्ष्व you enjoy, यथासुखम् be happy, मयि with me, लल  sport, ते your, बान्धवाः relatives, समेत्य collectively, त्वयि in you, ललन्तु will enjoy.

40012322.author: Translation
40012322.content: "O delightful one I will bestow you with heaps of riches and land. Therefore, enjoy with me drinking, sporting, and revelling. Accept me and be happy to sport with me.Let your elatives join you and enjoy all my wealth.

40012323.author: पदार्थः
40012323.content: भीरु a timid lady, कनकविमलहारभूषिताङ्गी deck yourself with pure gold necklace, कुसुमिततरुजालसन्ततानि with stretches of trees filled with blossoms, भ्रमरयुतानि with swarm of bees, समुद्रतीरजानि grown on the sea shore, काननानि in the forest groves, मया सह  with me, विहर you may enjoy.

40012323.author: Translation
40012323.content: "O timid lady embellish yourself with necklaces of pure gold and enjoy with me in the enchanting seaside forest groves full of trees with blossoms and swarming bees. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे विंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
